findings.rule: Title block and notes must not contradict each other for critical process specifications.
findings.reasoning: The title block field 'heat_treatment' is explicitly set to '---' (none), but note N5 specifies 'TO BE THROUGH HARDENED UPTO 55 HRC'. This contradiction will cause the manufacturer to either skip a required heat treatment or apply one that was not intended, resulting in a part with incorrect mechanical properties.
findings.correction: Update the title block 'heat_treatment' field to read 'Through Hardened 55 HRC' (or similar) so it matches note N5, or remove N5 if no heat treatment is required.

findings.rule: Specified hardness must be achievable for the given material grade.
findings.reasoning: Material C45 (medium carbon steel, ~0.45% C) has a practical maximum through-hardness of approximately 50–52 HRC even under ideal water quenching. Specifying 'UPTO 55 HRC' in N5 is at or beyond the metallurgical limit for this grade, making the requirement unreliable or impossible to consistently achieve without cracking.
findings.correction: Lower the target hardness in N5 to a realistic range for C45 (e.g., 45–50 HRC), or change the material to a low-alloy steel such as EN19 or EN24 that can reliably reach 55 HRC.

findings.rule: Functional mating surfaces on a coupling spacer require a defined tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: Feature F1 (outer cylindrical surface, ⌀66 per D1) is the primary functional interface of a coupling spacer yet carries no dimensional tolerance and no GD&T callout. Relying solely on the general machining tolerance of ±0.8 mm (for the 30–120 mm range) is far too loose for any coupling fit and leaves the design intent undefined.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., h7, H7, or a specific ± tolerance) to dimension D1 to control the outer diameter for its coupling function.

findings.rule: A bore serving as a functional fit surface must have a complete tolerance specification.
findings.reasoning: Feature F2 (inner cylindrical bore) is dimensioned by D2 which only shows '+0.2' with no nominal diameter value and no lower limit. As a functional bore on a coupling spacer, this incomplete tolerance makes it impossible to verify the intended fit or manufacture the feature correctly.
findings.correction: Provide the full nominal diameter and a bilateral or unilateral tolerance (e.g., ⌀XX +0.2/0 or a standard fit class like H7) for the inner bore dimension.
